System & margins

DBC H.4.6.3 caps safety factors at 10% sensible and 5% latent. Where diversity is not known, use ASHRAE Fundamentals Ch. 18 coefficients (DBC H.4.6.3).

Fresh air distribution

ASHRAE 62.1-2022 Table 6-4. Zone outdoor air = (Rp × people + Ra × area) / Ez.

Energy recovery · DBC H.4.8.2

Required above 1,000 L/s of treated outdoor air: recover at least 50% of exhaust air at 70% or higher sensible effectiveness. Applied to the FAHU load.

Orientation factors: wall/roof CLTD and solar gain through glass

Base CLTD for a medium-weight wall (ASHRAE group D) and insulated roof. The correction for your design conditions is applied automatically. Solar values are peak gain per m² of glass per unit SHGC, including a storage factor, for about 25°N in July.
